title: campus-lab site: plain-English copy, and stop painting a working policy red
body:
## Summary

Two presentation fixes to the published page; no change to the model, configs, tests or export.

**Colour meant the wrong thing.** Ten of thirteen policy cells were red because the policy is mostly isolation, so the page read as a failing network to anyone skimming. Now colour encodes *verified vs. broken*, not *allow vs. deny*: every cell that matches intent gets the same green `✓` with a `reaches` / `isolated` label; red `✗` is reserved for a cell that does not match intent (which currently never happens, and would fail CI). A legend and a "13 of 13 rules checked and correct" line say so explicitly.

**Written for a non-technical reader first.** Headline, intro, topology caption, legend, footer, and the device/cell detail panels are rewritten in plain English (e.g. clicking a cell now opens with *"The rules say a workstation must not reach switch mgmt. Both distribution switches stop it."* before the Batfish trace). Protocol detail (RPVST/HSRP/OSPF, the full check list) is kept verbatim one click away under `<details>Technical detail</details>`. Device panels gain a one-line plain description per role.

Checked in a browser at 1024px: matrix, cell click, device click and footer all render; no console errors.
